cd /workspace && cat > /workspace/dev/run_verify.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import gen as G
lo=int(sys.argv[1]); hi=int(sys.argv[2]); kind=sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv)>3 else 'hard'
bad=0; fb=0
for seed in range(lo, hi):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    if kind=='hard':
        nn=rng.choice([6,10,16,24]); pl=rng.choice([2,3,4,5,9])
        if pl>nn: pl=nn
        req = G.gen_plan_hard(rng, nf=22, nn=nn, pathlen=pl, cap=rng.choice([1,2,3,6,10]), equal=rng.random()<0.5)
    else:
        req = G.gen_plan_big(rng, nf=rng.randint(0,12))
    line = json.dumps(req)+'\n'
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/dev/main_verify.py'],input=line,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
    b = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/dev/bf.py'],input=line,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=1200)
    if r.stderr.strip(): fb += 1; print('FALLBACK', seed, r.stderr[:200])
    if r.stdout.strip() != b.stdout.strip():
        bad += 1; print('MISMATCH', seed, r.stdout[:200], b.stdout[:200])
        if bad>3: break
print(kind,'checked', hi-lo, 'mismatches', bad, 'fallbacks', fb)
PYEOF
